spans.s: Potana, nt. (= Pali id.), n. of a city, capital of the Aśmakas or (in Mv) Asmakas: read Potanaṃ (ms. cited as yo˚) Mv 〔iii.208.17〕.

potalaka, m.,
(1) also ˚ikā, f. (cf. Skt. pota, potaka, and go-potālikā in BR 〔7.1740〕; also AMg. poāla, poyāla), young (of an animal): nāga-˚ka(ḥ) Av 〔ii.127.9, 10〕; also kumbhāṇḍa-potalako vā ˚likā vā, Āṭānāṭika Sūtra, Hoffmann, Kl. Skt. Texte 5, 〔65.5—6〕; []
(2) n. of a mountain (also Pautalaka, q.v.): Mvy 〔4154〕; Avalokiteśvara dwells on it, Gv 〔208.8〕;
(3) n. of a maharṣi: Māy 〔256.25〕.
potāra, m. or nt., boat: loc. ˚re Gv 〔499.26〕; 〔500.3〕 (here misprinted ˚ro). Cf. Skt. pota, id.; see 〔§ 22.11〕.
